units.function: Database-backed minimal acquire/release contract harness for built-in local, fake sandbox and optional SSH runtime drivers.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest contract loop -> environment runtime and Secret services -> Drizzle/embedded Postgres plus optional SSH env-lab; no plugin/Connector SDK implementation, hostile provider or actual Agent execution is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Environment driver/config, company/Agent/Run, active/released lease and provider ID/driver metadata, null execution-workspace context and persisted private-key Secret reference.
units.lifecycle: Seed company/Agent/environment/Run -> optionally materialize SSH Secret -> acquire lease -> assert common fields -> release by Run -> assert no active rows -> release again as an empty idempotent result.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed and approved unsandboxed focused runs skipped 3/3 because embedded Postgres is unsupported. Even if executable, the contract covers only acquire/release success for built-ins and can false-pass the SSH case by returning when its fixture is unavailable. It is not a complete extension conformance suite.
units.designRationale: Pin a small common host invariant across initially supported environment drivers without duplicating the same lease assertions in each driver-specific test.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires a public, vendor-neutral Connector execution conformance suite proving lifecycle, security, failure and responsibility semantics for Raft, Codex, DeepSeek and enterprise runtimes.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as an SDK-owned black-box conformance kit covering capability/version negotiation, identity binding, acquire/resume/execute/stream/pause/approval/resume/cancel/timeout/release/destroy, idempotency/concurrency, Secret/data policy, evidence/result and signed attestation. Emit explicit PASS/SKIP/INFRA_ERROR and publish provider-neutral fixtures.
units.responsibilityConflict: The minimal lease links a Run and company but has no goal initiator, accountable human, Work/approval/data contract, capability proof or evidence. A provider can satisfy acquire/release while violating every responsibility-critical execution behavior.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL false conformance risk: no test executed locally and SSH can return as a pass when its fixture is unavailable. CRITICAL coverage gap: execute/cancel/timeout/stream/approval/evidence/attestation and Secret/data policy are absent. HIGH ecosystem gap: no third-party plugin implementation is tested against a public black-box contract. HIGH failure/concurrency gap: only success and empty second release are covered.
